findings.highlight: buffet me so violently I can't even see.
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音が流れ込んだ。
findings.governingReading: Through stress-numbed hearing come Berserker's roar, strong wind noise, and an explosive sound so great it overwhelms even vision.
findings.explanation: An overwhelming explosion entering numbed ears becomes wind and roars physically buffeting Shirou blind.

findings.highlight: Few Noble Phantasms can rival its elegant design and fine worksmanship.
findings.evidenceJa: 造型の細やかさ、鍛え上げられた鉄の巧みさで言えば、上回る宝具は数あろう。
findings.governingReading: Numerous Noble Phantasms surpass the sword in fine modeling and skilled ironwork; its superiority lies elsewhere.
findings.explanation: Many Noble Phantasms exceeding the sword in craftsmanship becomes few being able to rival it.

findings.highlight: Neither a relic of myth nor a work of mankind, it is a crystallization crafted from our feelings alone—a sword of pure fantasy, sitting at the apex.
findings.evidenceJa: 神話に寄らず、人ならざる業にも属さず、ただ想いだけで鍛え上げられた結晶だからこそ—あの剣は空想の身で、最強の座に在り続ける。
findings.governingReading: The sword relies neither on myth nor on inhuman/nonhuman art; it is forged from human thought alone.
findings.explanation: A sword outside nonhuman craft becomes not a work of mankind.

findings.highlight: Behind Saber, something that looks like the eviscerated corpse of Berserker sinks into the dark Shadow.
findings.evidenceJa: 目の前に剣を突きつけられ、セイバーの背後では、バーサーカーの亡骸らしきものが、黒い影に沈んでいた。
findings.governingReading: Something resembling Berserker's corpse is sinking into the Shadow.
findings.explanation: The English adds disembowelment to the apparent corpse while retaining uncertainty through 'looks like.' This supports a separate finding about added gore, not a claim about Saber's motives.

findings.highlight: Illya just watched her Servant die in battle.
findings.evidenceJa: 自らのサーヴァントの敗北と、目前に迫った死。
findings.governingReading: Illya faces both her Servant's defeat and death immediately threatening her.
findings.explanation: The explanation of Illya's fear loses the immediate threat to her own life. It describes her witnessing Berserker's death instead of facing both his defeat and approaching death herself.

findings.highlight: Now that her helmet is broken, I should be able to do some damage if I go for the head.
findings.evidenceJa: 兜を砕かれた、という事は頭部になんらかのダメージを負っている筈だ。
findings.governingReading: Shirou infers that because the helm was broken, Saber must already have sustained some damage to the head, and chooses that point.
findings.explanation: A broken helm implying prior head injury becomes an opportunity to inflict head damage.

findings.highlight: Unless I imagine myself fully committing to this, I don't have a chance against her...!
findings.evidenceJa: その、絶対のイメージの下で斬り合わなければ、セイバーとは勝負にもなり得ない—！
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes he cannot even contest Saber unless he fights under an absolute image in which he himself survives and defeats the enemy.
findings.explanation: A precise absolute image of surviving and defeating Saber becomes generic full commitment.

findings.highlight: It's a slash precise enough to cut a grain of rice, coming for Shirou Emiya's head.
findings.evidenceJa: 稲穂を刈る鋭さで、衛宮士郎の無防備な首を薙ぎ払う。
findings.governingReading: The blade sweeps Shirou's exposed neck with the sharpness used to reap ears/stalks of rice.
findings.explanation: A slash sharp enough to reap rice stalks becomes one precise enough to cut a grain of rice.

findings.highlight: Saber's sword stops just shy of my neck.
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの剣は、俺の薄皮一枚で止まっている。
findings.governingReading: The sword has reached Shirou and stops at the thin skin of his neck, leaving his head attached.
findings.explanation: Saber's blade stopping at a single layer of skin becomes stopping shy of the neck.
